reply.text:
I can't give you a dose on RAD140 or any SARM, and I won't put a stack together. That's one for a doctor, not a coach. These compounds aren't approved for use, and what they do to your hormones is something only a physician who can run bloodwork should weigh in on.

What I can do is the training side of a bulk. Progressive overload on the big lifts, enough sleep, and eating enough protein and total food will carry you a long way, and I can build the block. Tell me your days per week and how long you have per session, and I'll set it up.
